title: 1 v 1 Skate Touch Battle to 2 v 1
description: Players race to a loose puck, must use a skate as the first touch, battle for possession, then immediately turn the win into a 2-on-1 attack.
coaching_points: Win inside body position before trying to play the puck.
Use the skate intentionally on the first touch.
Transition immediately from the battle win into offense.

title: Buffalo 4 v 3 Continuous D Activation
description: A continuous transition game where possession must move through a defenseman before one D activates to create a 4-on-3 attack, then the roles reverse on the turnover.
coaching_points: Activate only after reading controlled possession and open ice.
Use D-to-D movement to change the point of attack.
Forwards recognize and use the activated defenseman as the extra attacker.
Transition immediately when possession changes.

title: Soft Catch While Attacking Up & Downhill
description: Players receive rimmed pucks along the wall while skating both downhill and uphill, using a soft catch across the body to maintain momentum before attacking the net.
coaching_points: Start slower until the timing of the rim and catch is clean.
Stay slightly off the wall to keep both turn options available.
Let the puck travel across the body before catching it so momentum is preserved.

title: 2v1 4v2
description: A three-part rush progression that starts 2-on-1, expands into a 4-on-2, and finishes with a tracking backchecker applying pressure to the next rush.
coaching_points: Attack the first 2-on-1 with speed and clear spacing.
Defensemen manage gap and body position through the rush.
Transition quickly as the second wave joins.
The high forward tracks hard and pressures the next attack.

title: 2 on 1 Preds
description: Begins as a tight down-low 2-on-1, turns into an immediate tracking and puck-recovery sequence, then finishes with a long 2-on-1 rush after a regroup.
coaching_points: Make the first down-low play quickly and attack the net.
Track immediately after the chance to pressure the next puck.
Defensemen recover inside position before defending the long rush.
Move rapidly from offense to defense and back to offense.

title: Good Stick 2 v 2 or 3 v 3
description: A cross-ice 2-on-2 or 3-on-3 game where one team is restricted to using one hand, forcing better stick position, body leverage, puck support, and quick decisions.
coaching_points: Lead with the stick and take away lanes early.
Use body position instead of reaching or over-skating.
Support the puck and protect it when operating under the one-hand restriction.
Make fast decisions and move the puck before pressure closes.

title: 4 v 2 Continuous Zone Entry
description: Four attackers enter against two defenders, attack off the rush or retain possession, and the game continues when the defenders win the puck and spring the next group.
coaching_points: Attack quickly with a net driver and a weak-side option.
Defenders keep sticks in lanes and force play outside.
On change of possession, transition immediately into the next attack.
Keep the game continuous and competitive.

title: Quick Touch Passing & Shooting
description: Players exchange several quick passes, open around the circle, move the puck through the next player in line, then break into the slot for a quick shot off the return pass.
coaching_points: Use crisp passes and communicate throughout the sequence.
Keep sticks on the ice and present a clear target.
Open up to receive the puck in motion.
Release the shot quickly off the final pass.
